functions.name: Esys_TRSess_GetAttributes
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_TRSess_GetAttributes(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR session, TPMA_SESSION *flags);
functions.description: Get the attribute flags for an ESYS session handle (e.g., audit, continueSession flags).
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
session must be a valid ESYS_TR session handle.
flags must be a non-NULL output pointer.
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_TRSess_SetAttributes
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_TRSess_SetAttributes(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR session, TPMA_SESSION flags, TPMA_SESSION mask);
functions.description: Set selected session attributes on an ESYS session using a mask to indicate which bits to modify.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
session must be a valid ESYS_TR session handle.
Only attributes indicated by mask will be modified; valid bits and combinations follow TPM/ESAPI rules (details not in header).
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_TRSess_GetNonceTPM
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_TRSess_GetNonceTPM(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR session, TPM2B_NONCE **nonceTPM);
functions.description: Obtain the TPM’s nonce associated with the session handle.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
session must be a valid ESYS_TR session.
nonceTPM must be a non-NULL output pointer; allocation/free semantics not stated (likely Esys_Free to free).
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_TR_GetTpmHandle
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_TR_GetTpmHandle(ESYS_CONTEXT *esys_context, ESYS_TR esys_handle, TPM2_HANDLE *tpm_handle);
functions.description: Map an ESYS_TR handle to its underlying raw TPM2_HANDLE value.
requirements: esys_context must be valid.
esys_handle must be a valid ESYS_TR.
tpm_handle must be a non-NULL output pointer to receive the TPM handle value.
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_TRSess_GetAuthRequired
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_TRSess_GetAuthRequired(ESYS_CONTEXT *esys_context, ESYS_TR esys_handle, TPMI_YES_NO *auth_needed);
functions.description: Report whether authorization is required for operations using the given handle or session.
requirements: esys_context must be valid.
esys_handle must be a valid ESYS_TR.
auth_needed must be a non-NULL output pointer to receive a TPMI_YES_NO.
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_Startup
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Startup(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2_SU startupType);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_Startup command to initialize the TPM after reset with the specified startup type.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
startupType must be a valid TPM2_SU value per TPM spec.
Should be among the first commands after transport is available; calling policy constraints per TPM spec (not detailed here).
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_Startup_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Startup_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2_SU startupType);
functions.description: Begin asynchronous TPM2_Startup operation.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
startupType must be valid.
Must follow with Esys_Startup_Finish to complete.
Do not start other async operations on same context before finishing (typical ESAPI pattern; exact constraints not stated).
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_Startup_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Startup_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext);
functions.description: Complete a previously started TPM2_Startup asynchronous operation.
requirements: esysContext must be valid and have a pending Esys_Startup_Async.
Must not be called without matching Async.
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_Shutdown
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Shutdown(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, TPM2_SU shutdownType);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_Shutdown to orderly or state-saving shutdown the TPM.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
shandle1/shandle2/shandle3 must be valid session handles or ESYS_TR_NONE, as allowed by TPM2_Shutdown authorization rules.
shutdownType must be a valid TPM2_SU.
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_Shutdown_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Shutdown_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, TPM2_SU shutdownType);
functions.description: Begin asynchronous TPM2_Shutdown operation.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
Session handles must be valid or ESYS_TR_NONE as appropriate.
Must be completed with Esys_Shutdown_Finish before reusing the context for other async operations.
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_Shutdown_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Shutdown_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext);
functions.description: Complete a previously started Esys_Shutdown_Async.
requirements: esysContext must be valid and have a pending Esys_Shutdown_Async.
Must not be called without a matching Async.
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_SelfTest
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_SelfTest(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, TPMI_YES_NO fullTest);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_SelfTest command to run full or incremental self-tests in the TPM.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
Session handles must be valid or ESYS_TR_NONE per authorization requirements.
fullTest must be a valid TPMI_YES_NO value.
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_SelfTest_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_SelfTest_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, TPMI_YES_NO fullTest);
functions.description: Begin asynchronous TPM2_SelfTest.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
Session handles must be valid or ESYS_TR_NONE.
Must complete with Esys_SelfTest_Finish.
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_SelfTest_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_SelfTest_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext);
functions.description: Complete a previously started Esys_SelfTest_Async.
requirements: esysContext must be valid and must have a pending Esys_SelfTest_Async.
Must not be called without a matching Async.
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_IncrementalSelfTest
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_IncrementalSelfTest(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPML_ALG *toTest, TPML_ALG **toDoList);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_IncrementalSelfTest to test selected algorithms and return a list of remaining algorithms to test.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
Session handles must be valid or ESYS_TR_NONE as permitted.
toTest must be a non-NULL pointer to a list of algorithms to test.
toDoList must be a non-NULL output pointer; the callee allocates the returned list (freeing method not stated here).
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_IncrementalSelfTest_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_IncrementalSelfTest_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPML_ALG *toTest);
functions.description: Begin asynchronous TPM2_IncrementalSelfTest.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
Session handles must be valid or ESYS_TR_NONE as appropriate.
toTest must be non-NULL.
Must complete with Esys_IncrementalSelfTest_Finish.
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_IncrementalSelfTest_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_IncrementalSelfTest_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPML_ALG **toDoList);
functions.description: Complete a previously started Esys_IncrementalSelfTest_Async and return the remaining algorithms to test.
requirements: esysContext must be valid and have a pending Esys_IncrementalSelfTest_Async.
toDoList must be a non-NULL output pointer; allocation/free semantics not specified here.
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_GetTestResult
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_GetTestResult(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, TPM2B_MAX_BUFFER **outData, TPM2_RC *testResult);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_GetTestResult to retrieve test output and a TPM-level return code from the most recent test operation.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
Session handles must be valid or ESYS_TR_NONE per authorization requirements.
outData must be a non-NULL output pointer; the callee allocates the buffer (freeing method not specified).
testResult must be a non-NULL output pointer to receive a TPM2_RC.
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_GetTestResult_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_GetTestResult_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3);
functions.description: Begin asynchronous TPM2_GetTestResult operation.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
Session handles must be valid or ESYS_TR_NONE.
Must finish with Esys_GetTestResult_Finish.
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_GetTestResult_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_GetTestResult_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2B_MAX_BUFFER **outData, TPM2_RC *testResult);
functions.description: Complete a previously started Esys_GetTestResult_Async and return test output and TPM test result code.
requirements: esysContext must be valid and have a pending Esys_GetTestResult_Async.
outData must be a non-NULL output pointer (callee-allocated).
testResult must be a non-NULL output pointer.
Check return code.

functions.name: Esys_StartAuthSession
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_StartAuthSession(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR tpmKey, ESYS_TR bind, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_NONCE *nonceCaller, TPM2_SE sessionType, const TPMT_SYM_DEF *symmetric, TPMI_ALG_HASH authHash, ESYS_TR *sessionHandle);
functions.description: Starts a TPM authorization session (HMAC, policy, or trial). This is the synchronous one-call wrapper that sends the command and waits for completion, returning a new ESYS_TR session handle in sessionHandle.
requirements: esysContext must be a valid ESAPI context initialized by Esys_Initialize.
sessionHandle must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the created session handle.
nonceCaller, symmetric must point to properly initialized structures if provided by the caller; exact size/content constraints are TPM-defined and not stated here.
tpmKey and bind must be valid ESYS_TR handles or ESYS_TR_NONE as appropriate for the desired session.
shandle1, shandle2, shandle3 are optional session authorization handles (or ESYS_TR_NONE) for the command.
sessionType must be a valid TPM2_SE value; authHash must be a supported hash algorithm for the TPM.
On TSS2_RC return values other than TSS2_RC_SUCCESS, callers should not use sessionHandle.

functions.name: Esys_StartAuthSession_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_StartAuthSession_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR tpmKey, ESYS_TR bind, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_NONCE *nonceCaller, TPM2_SE sessionType, const TPMT_SYM_DEF *symmetric, TPMI_ALG_HASH authHash);
functions.description: Asynchronously initiates a TPM authorization session. Must be followed by Esys_StartAuthSession_Finish to complete and retrieve the session handle.
requirements: esysContext must be valid and idle (no other pending asynchronous command on this context).
After a successful _Async call, the same esysContext must be completed with Esys_StartAuthSession_Finish before issuing another ESYS command on this context.
Parameters tpmKey, bind, shandle1..3, nonceCaller, sessionType, symmetric, authHash follow the same constraints as Esys_StartAuthSession.

functions.name: Esys_StartAuthSession_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_StartAuthSession_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR *sessionHandle);
functions.description: Completes an asynchronous Esys_StartAuthSession begun with Esys_StartAuthSession_Async and returns the created ESYS_TR session handle.
requirements: esysContext must have a pending Esys_StartAuthSession_Async operation.
sessionHandle must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the result.
Must not be called if no matching _Async was issued or after it has already been finished.

functions.name: Esys_PolicyRestart
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_PolicyRestart(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR sessionHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3);
functions.description: Resets a policy session’s policy digest and state. Synchronous variant that sends the command and waits for completion.
requirements: esysContext must be initialized and valid.
sessionHandle must refer to a policy session (ESYS_TR).
shandle1, shandle2, shandle3 are optional session authorization handles or ESYS_TR_NONE.

functions.name: Esys_PolicyRestart_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_PolicyRestart_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR sessionHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3);
functions.description: Asynchronously initiates a policy session restart. Complete with Esys_PolicyRestart_Finish.
requirements: esysContext must be valid and have no other in-flight async command.
sessionHandle must identify a policy session.
A matching Esys_PolicyRestart_Finish must be called to complete the operation before reusing esysContext.

functions.name: Esys_PolicyRestart_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_PolicyRestart_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext);
functions.description: Completes an asynchronous Esys_PolicyRestart operation.
requirements: esysContext must correspond to a pending Esys_PolicyRestart_Async.
Do not call without a matching _Async or more than once per _Async call.

functions.name: Esys_Create
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Create(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR parentHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_SENSITIVE_CREATE *inSensitive, const TPM2B_PUBLIC *inPublic, const TPM2B_DATA *outsideInfo, const TPML_PCR_SELECTION *creationPCR, TPM2B_PRIVATE **outPrivate, TPM2B_PUBLIC **outPublic, TPM2B_CREATION_DATA **creationData, TPM2B_DIGEST **creationHash, TPMT_TK_CREATION **creationTicket);
functions.description: Creates a new TPM object under a parent key, returning the public and private blobs and creation data. Synchronous convenience wrapper.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
parentHandle must refer to a loaded parent key capable of object creation.
inSensitive and inPublic must point to properly initialized templates for the object to create; other inputs are optional per TPM rules.
outPrivate, outPublic, creationData, creationHash, creationTicket must be non-NULL pointers to receive callee-allocated outputs; caller must free using Esys_Free.
shandle1..3 are optional authorization session handles (or ESYS_TR_NONE).
On error returns, output pointers may be left unset; caller must check return code before use.

functions.name: Esys_Create_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Create_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR parentHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_SENSITIVE_CREATE *inSensitive, const TPM2B_PUBLIC *inPublic, const TPM2B_DATA *outsideInfo, const TPML_PCR_SELECTION *creationPCR);
functions.description: Asynchronously initiates object creation under a parent. Completion data retrieved via Esys_Create_Finish.
requirements: esysContext must be valid and idle (no pending async).
parentHandle must be a valid parent object handle.
Parameters mirror Esys_Create; outputs are obtained via _Finish.
Must call Esys_Create_Finish before issuing another command on the same esysContext.

functions.name: Esys_Create_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Create_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2B_PRIVATE **outPrivate, TPM2B_PUBLIC **outPublic, TPM2B_CREATION_DATA **creationData, TPM2B_DIGEST **creationHash, TPMT_TK_CREATION **creationTicket);
functions.description: Completes an asynchronous Esys_Create and returns the created object blobs and creation data.
requirements: esysContext must correspond to a pending Esys_Create_Async.
All output parameters must be non-NULL pointers to receive callee-allocated results; caller must free via Esys_Free.
Must not be called more than once per _Async call.

functions.name: Esys_Load
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Load(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR parentHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_PRIVATE *inPrivate, const TPM2B_PUBLIC *inPublic, ESYS_TR *objectHandle);
functions.description: Loads a TPM object into the TPM under a specified parent using public and private blobs, returning a new ESYS_TR for the loaded object. Synchronous.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
parentHandle must refer to the correct parent of inPrivate/inPublic.
inPrivate and inPublic must be valid matching blobs produced by TPM2_Create/Import.
objectHandle must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the loaded ESYS_TR handle.
shandle1..3 are optional authorization sessions.

functions.name: Esys_Load_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Load_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR parentHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_PRIVATE *inPrivate, const TPM2B_PUBLIC *inPublic);
functions.description: Asynchronously initiates loading an object into the TPM. Complete with Esys_Load_Finish to receive the loaded handle.
requirements: esysContext must be valid and have no other in-flight command.
parentHandle must be valid; inPrivate and inPublic must be provided and valid.
Call Esys_Load_Finish to complete and retrieve the ESYS_TR handle before issuing another command on the same context.

functions.name: Esys_Load_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Load_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR *objectHandle);
functions.description: Completes an asynchronous Esys_Load and returns the loaded object’s ESYS_TR handle.
requirements: esysContext must correspond to a pending Esys_Load_Async.
objectHandle must be non-NULL.
Do not call more than once per matching _Async.

functions.name: Esys_LoadExternal
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_LoadExternal(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_SENSITIVE *inPrivate, const TPM2B_PUBLIC *inPublic, ESYS_TR hierarchy, ESYS_TR *objectHandle);
functions.description: Loads an external (non-TPM-generated) key or object into the TPM for limited use, returning an ESYS_TR handle. Synchronous.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
inPublic must describe the external object; inPrivate may be NULL for public-only loads, per TPM rules (not specified here).
hierarchy must be a valid ESYS_TR hierarchy handle (e.g., ESYS_TR_RH_OWNER/ENDORSEMENT/NULL).
objectHandle must be non-NULL to receive the ESYS_TR of the loaded object.
shandle1..3 are optional authorization sessions as required by the TPM command context.

functions.name: Esys_LoadExternal_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_LoadExternal_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_SENSITIVE *inPrivate, const TPM2B_PUBLIC *inPublic, ESYS_TR hierarchy);
functions.description: Asynchronously initiates loading an external object. Must be completed with Esys_LoadExternal_Finish.
requirements: esysContext must be valid and idle.
Parameters mirror Esys_LoadExternal; outputs are obtained via _Finish.
A matching Esys_LoadExternal_Finish must be called before reusing esysContext.

functions.name: Esys_LoadExternal_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_LoadExternal_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR *objectHandle);
functions.description: Completes an asynchronous Esys_LoadExternal, returning the ESYS_TR handle.
requirements: esysContext must correspond to a pending Esys_LoadExternal_Async.
objectHandle must be a non-NULL pointer.
Call exactly once per matching _Async.

functions.name: Esys_ReadPublic
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ReadPublic(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR objectHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, TPM2B_PUBLIC **outPublic, TPM2B_NAME **name, TPM2B_NAME **qualifiedName);
functions.description: Reads the public area, name, and qualified name of a TPM object. Synchronous convenience wrapper.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
objectHandle must be a valid ESYS_TR object handle.
outPublic, name, qualifiedName must be non-NULL pointers to receive callee-allocated results; caller must free with Esys_Free.
shandle1..3 are optional session handles.

functions.name: Esys_ReadPublic_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ReadPublic_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR objectHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3);
functions.description: Asynchronously initiates a ReadPublic for the given object. Complete with Esys_ReadPublic_Finish to get results.
requirements: esysContext must be valid and have no pending async operation.
objectHandle must be valid.
Must call Esys_ReadPublic_Finish before issuing another command on the same esysContext.

functions.name: Esys_ReadPublic_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ReadPublic_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2B_PUBLIC **outPublic, TPM2B_NAME **name, TPM2B_NAME **qualifiedName);
functions.description: Completes an asynchronous Esys_ReadPublic and returns the object’s public area and names.
requirements: esysContext must match a pending Esys_ReadPublic_Async.
All three output pointers must be non-NULL to receive results; caller frees with Esys_Free.
Call exactly once per matching _Async.

functions.name: Esys_ActivateCredential
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ActivateCredential(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR activateHandle, ESYS_TR keyHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_ID_OBJECT *credentialBlob, const TPM2B_ENCRYPTED_SECRET *secret, TPM2B_DIGEST **certInfo);
functions.description: Uses a restricted decryption key to decrypt a credential blob targeted at activateHandle, returning the clear credential (certInfo). Synchronous.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
activateHandle must reference the object whose credential is being activated; keyHandle must be a suitable decryption (e.g., RSA/ECC) key.
credentialBlob and secret must be valid structures produced by TPM2_MakeCredential (or equivalent).
certInfo must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the callee-allocated result; caller frees with Esys_Free.
shandle1..3 are optional authorization sessions appropriate for both handles.

functions.name: Esys_ActivateCredential_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ActivateCredential_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR activateHandle, ESYS_TR keyHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_ID_OBJECT *credentialBlob, const TPM2B_ENCRYPTED_SECRET *secret);
functions.description: Asynchronously initiates credential activation. Complete with Esys_ActivateCredential_Finish to retrieve the decrypted credential.
requirements: esysContext must be valid and idle.
activateHandle, keyHandle, credentialBlob, secret must be valid as per Esys_ActivateCredential.
Must complete with Esys_ActivateCredential_Finish before reusing esysContext.

functions.name: Esys_ActivateCredential_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ActivateCredential_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2B_DIGEST **certInfo);
functions.description: Completes an asynchronous Esys_ActivateCredential and returns the decrypted credential digest.
requirements: esysContext must correspond to a pending Esys_ActivateCredential_Async.
certInfo must be a non-NULL pointer; caller frees with Esys_Free.
Call once per matching _Async.

functions.name: Esys_ACT_SetTimeout
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ACT_SetTimeout(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR actHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, UINT32 startTimeout);
functions.description: Sets the timeout value for an ACT (Authorized Countdown Timer) resource. Synchronous.
requirements: esysContext must be valid.
actHandle must reference a valid ACT handle.
startTimeout must be within TPM-accepted range (exact limits not stated here).
shandle1..3 are optional authorization sessions suitable for the ACT hierarchy.

functions.name: Esys_ACT_SetTimeout_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ACT_SetTimeout_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR actHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, UINT32 startTimeout);
functions.description: Asynchronously initiates an ACT timeout update. Complete with Esys_ACT_SetTimeout_Finish.
requirements: esysContext must be valid and idle.
actHandle must be a valid ACT handle; startTimeout must be a TPM-accepted value (limits not specified here).
Must call Esys_ACT_SetTimeout_Finish before reusing esysContext.

functions.name: Esys_ACT_SetTimeout_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ACT_SetTimeout_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext);
functions.description: Completes an asynchronous Esys_ACT_SetTimeout operation.
requirements: esysContext must correspond to a pending Esys_ACT_SetTimeout_Async.
Call exactly once per matching _Async.

functions.name: Esys_AC_GetCapability_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_AC_GetCapability_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR optionalSession1, ESYS_TR optionalSession2, ESYS_TR optionalSession3, ESYS_TR ac, TPM_AT capability, UINT32 count);
functions.description: Starts the asynchronous TPM2_AC_GetCapability command to query AC (Authorization Context) capabilities. Use Esys_AC_GetCapability_Finish to complete and retrieve results.
requirements: esysContext must be a valid, initialized ESYS_CONTEXT.
ac must reference a valid ESYS_TR for an AC object on the TPM.
optionalSession{1..3} must be valid session handles or ESYS_TR_NONE.
Must call Esys_AC_GetCapability_Finish to complete the operation before reusing esysContext for another command.

functions.name: Esys_AC_GetCapability_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_AC_GetCapability_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPMI_YES_NO *moreData, TPML_AC_CAPABILITIES **capabilityData);
functions.description: Completes a pending Esys_AC_GetCapability_Async call and returns whether more data is available and the AC capability data.
requirements: Must be called only after a successful Esys_AC_GetCapability_Async on the same esysContext.
moreData must be a valid pointer if provided to receive a flag; capabilityData must be a non-NULL pointer to receive a callee-allocated structure; caller must free via Esys_Free.
esysContext must not be used for another pending command when Finish is called.

functions.name: Esys_AC_GetCapability
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_AC_GetCapability(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR optionalSession1, ESYS_TR optionalSession2, ESYS_TR optionalSession3, ESYS_TR ac, TPM_AT capability, UINT32 count, TPMI_YES_NO *moreData, TPML_AC_CAPABILITIES **capabilityData);
functions.description: One-call wrapper around TPM2_AC_GetCapability that queries AC capability information and returns results synchronously.
requirements: esysContext must be valid and initialized.
ac must be a valid AC handle; optionalSession{1..3} valid or ESYS_TR_NONE.
moreData must be a valid pointer; capabilityData must be a non-NULL out-parameter; returned memory is callee-allocated and must be freed with Esys_Free.

functions.name: Esys_AC_Send_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_AC_Send_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR sendObject, ESYS_TR nvAuthHandle, ESYS_TR optionalSession1, ESYS_TR optionalSession2, ESYS_TR optionalSession3, ESYS_TR ac, TPM2B_MAX_BUFFER *acDataIn);
functions.description: Starts the asynchronous TPM2_AC_Send command to send data to an AC, optionally authorizing with an NV handle and sendObject.
requirements: esysContext must be valid and command not already pending.
sendObject, nvAuthHandle, and ac must be valid handles as required by the TPM for AC_Send.
acDataIn may be NULL depending on command semantics; if provided, it must point to a valid TPM2B_MAX_BUFFER.
Must call Esys_AC_Send_Finish to complete.

functions.name: Esys_AC_Send_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_AC_Send_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPMS_AC_OUTPUT **acDataOut);
functions.description: Completes a pending Esys_AC_Send_Async and returns the AC output data.
requirements: Must follow a prior Esys_AC_Send_Async on the same context.
acDataOut must be a valid pointer to receive a callee-allocated structure; free with Esys_Free.
esysContext must not have another unfinished command.

functions.name: Esys_AC_Send
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_AC_Send(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR sendObject, ESYS_TR nvAuthHandle, ESYS_TR optionalSession1, ESYS_TR optionalSession2, ESYS_TR optionalSession3, ESYS_TR ac, TPM2B_MAX_BUFFER *acDataIn, TPMS_AC_OUTPUT **acDataOut);
functions.description: Synchronous wrapper for TPM2_AC_Send to send data to an AC and receive output in one call.
requirements: esysContext must be initialized.
sendObject, nvAuthHandle, and ac must be valid handles with appropriate authorizations set via sessions.
acDataOut must be non-NULL; returned memory is callee-allocated and must be freed with Esys_Free.

functions.name: Esys_Policy_AC_SendSelect_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Policy_AC_SendSelect_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR policySession1, ESYS_TR optionalSession2, ESYS_TR optionalSession3, TPM2B_NAME *objectName, TPM2B_NAME *authHandleName, TPM2B_NAME *acName, const TPMI_YES_NO includeObject);
functions.description: Starts asynchronous TPM2_Policy_AC_SendSelect to add AC selection constraints to a policy session.
requirements: policySession1 must refer to a policy session handle.
objectName, authHandleName, acName must point to valid TPM2B_NAME structures as required; may be NULL per TPM semantics if allowed (unknown from header).
Must call Esys_Policy_AC_SendSelect_Finish to complete.

functions.name: Esys_Policy_AC_SendSelect_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Policy_AC_SendSelect_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext);
functions.description: Completes a pending Esys_Policy_AC_SendSelect_Async call.
requirements: Must be preceded by Esys_Policy_AC_SendSelect_Async on the same context.
No out-parameters; check return code for success.
esysContext must not have another pending command.

functions.name: Esys_Policy_AC_SendSelect
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Policy_AC_SendSelect(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR policySession1, ESYS_TR optionalSession2, ESYS_TR optionalSession3, TPM2B_NAME *objectName, TPM2B_NAME *authHandleName, TPM2B_NAME *acName, TPMI_YES_NO includeObject);
functions.description: Synchronous wrapper for TPM2_Policy_AC_SendSelect to update a policy with AC selection constraints.
requirements: policySession1 must be a valid policy session.
objectName/authHandleName/acName must be valid names when provided.
esysContext must be valid and initialized.

functions.name: Esys_MakeCredential
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_MakeCredential(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR handle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_DIGEST *credential, const TPM2B_NAME *objectName, TPM2B_ID_OBJECT **credentialBlob, TPM2B_ENCRYPTED_SECRET **secret);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_MakeCredential: encrypts a credential for a TPM-resident key, producing a credential blob and secret for activation.
requirements: handle must be a valid public key handle capable of MakeCredential (e.g., EK or similar).
credential and objectName must point to valid structures; sizes must adhere to TPM limits.
credentialBlob and secret must be non-NULL out-parameters; returned buffers are callee-allocated and must be freed with Esys_Free.

functions.name: Esys_MakeCredential_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_MakeCredential_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR handle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_DIGEST *credential, const TPM2B_NAME *objectName);
functions.description: Starts asynchronous TPM2_MakeCredential to generate a credential blob for a named object.
requirements: handle must be a valid key handle for MakeCredential.
credential and objectName must be valid pointers as per TPM types.
Must call Esys_MakeCredential_Finish to retrieve outputs.

functions.name: Esys_MakeCredential_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_MakeCredential_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2B_ID_OBJECT **credentialBlob, TPM2B_ENCRYPTED_SECRET **secret);
functions.description: Completes a pending Esys_MakeCredential_Async and returns the credential blob and secret.
requirements: Must follow Esys_MakeCredential_Async on same context.
credentialBlob and secret must be valid pointers to receive callee-allocated buffers; free with Esys_Free.
No other command may be pending on esysContext.

functions.name: Esys_Unseal
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Unseal(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR itemHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, TPM2B_SENSITIVE_DATA **outData);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_Unseal: returns the sensitive data from a sealed object when policy/auth conditions are satisfied.
requirements: itemHandle must be a loaded sealed data object handle.
Appropriate authorization sessions (shandle1..3) must be set to satisfy the object's auth/policy.
outData must be non-NULL; returned buffer is callee-allocated and must be freed with Esys_Free.

functions.name: Esys_Unseal_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Unseal_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR itemHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3);
functions.description: Starts asynchronous TPM2_Unseal on a sealed data object.
requirements: itemHandle must be a valid sealed object handle.
Authorization sessions must be valid and configured before the call.
Call Esys_Unseal_Finish to retrieve the result.

functions.name: Esys_Unseal_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Unseal_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2B_SENSITIVE_DATA **outData);
functions.description: Completes a pending Esys_Unseal_Async and returns the unsealed data.
requirements: Must be called after Esys_Unseal_Async on the same esysContext.
outData must be a valid pointer; the returned structure is callee-allocated and must be freed with Esys_Free.
No other command may be pending on esysContext.

functions.name: Esys_ObjectChangeAuth
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ObjectChangeAuth(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR objectHandle, ESYS_TR parentHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_AUTH *newAuth, TPM2B_PRIVATE **outPrivate);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_ObjectChangeAuth: changes an object’s auth value, producing a new private blob that can be loaded by the parent.
requirements: objectHandle must be a loaded object; parentHandle must be its parent handle or a compatible parent.
newAuth must point to the new auth value; size within TPM2B_AUTH limits.
outPrivate must be non-NULL; returned private is callee-allocated and must be freed with Esys_Free.

functions.name: Esys_ObjectChangeAuth_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ObjectChangeAuth_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR objectHandle, ESYS_TR parentHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_AUTH *newAuth);
functions.description: Starts asynchronous TPM2_ObjectChangeAuth to change an object’s authorization value.
requirements: objectHandle and parentHandle must be valid and authorized.
newAuth must be a valid TPM2B_AUTH pointer.
Call Esys_ObjectChangeAuth_Finish to obtain outPrivate.

functions.name: Esys_ObjectChangeAuth_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ObjectChangeAuth_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2B_PRIVATE **outPrivate);
functions.description: Completes a pending Esys_ObjectChangeAuth_Async and returns the updated private blob.
requirements: Must follow Esys_ObjectChangeAuth_Async on same context.
outPrivate must be a valid pointer; returned structure is callee-allocated; free with Esys_Free.
No other unfinished command on esysContext.

functions.name: Esys_CreateLoaded
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_CreateLoaded(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR parentHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_SENSITIVE_CREATE *inSensitive, const TPM2B_TEMPLATE *inPublic, ESYS_TR *objectHandle, TPM2B_PRIVATE **outPrivate, TPM2B_PUBLIC **outPublic);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_CreateLoaded: creates and loads a child object under a parent, returning a loaded handle and its public/private data.
requirements: parentHandle must reference a loaded parent (e.g., primary or other key) with create permissions.
inSensitive and inPublic must be valid pointers to creation parameters.
objectHandle must be non-NULL to receive the created handle; outPrivate/outPublic must be non-NULL if data is required; returned buffers are callee-allocated and must be freed with Esys_Free.

functions.name: Esys_CreateLoaded_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_CreateLoaded_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR parentHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_SENSITIVE_CREATE *inSensitive, const TPM2B_TEMPLATE *inPublic);
functions.description: Starts asynchronous TPM2_CreateLoaded to create and load an object under the given parent.
requirements: parentHandle must be valid and authorized for object creation.
inSensitive and inPublic must be valid pointers to parameters.
Call Esys_CreateLoaded_Finish to get outputs.

functions.name: Esys_CreateLoaded_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_CreateLoaded_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR *objectHandle, TPM2B_PRIVATE **outPrivate, TPM2B_PUBLIC **outPublic);
functions.description: Completes a pending Esys_CreateLoaded_Async and returns the loaded handle and public/private data.
requirements: Must follow Esys_CreateLoaded_Async on same context.
objectHandle must be a valid pointer; outPrivate/outPublic must be valid if outputs are desired; returned buffers are callee-allocated and must be freed with Esys_Free.
esysContext must have no other pending command.

functions.name: Esys_Duplicate
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Duplicate(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR objectHandle, ESYS_TR newParentHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_DATA *encryptionKeyIn, const TPMT_SYM_DEF_OBJECT *symmetricAlg, TPM2B_DATA **encryptionKeyOut, TPM2B_PRIVATE **duplicate, TPM2B_ENCRYPTED_SECRET **outSymSeed);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_Duplicate: creates a duplicate of an object for import under a new parent, optionally using symmetric protection.
requirements: objectHandle must be a loaded object; newParentHandle must be a suitable parent for import.
If provided, encryptionKeyIn and symmetricAlg must be valid per TPM spec.
encryptionKeyOut, duplicate, outSymSeed must be valid pointers to receive callee-allocated data; free with Esys_Free.

functions.name: Esys_Duplicate_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Duplicate_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR objectHandle, ESYS_TR newParentHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_DATA *encryptionKeyIn, const TPMT_SYM_DEF_OBJECT *symmetricAlg);
functions.description: Starts asynchronous TPM2_Duplicate to prepare an object for import to a new parent.
requirements: objectHandle and newParentHandle must be valid and properly authorized.
encryptionKeyIn and symmetricAlg (if not NULL) must be valid.
Call Esys_Duplicate_Finish to retrieve outputs.

functions.name: Esys_Duplicate_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Duplicate_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2B_DATA **encryptionKeyOut, TPM2B_PRIVATE **duplicate, TPM2B_ENCRYPTED_SECRET **outSymSeed);
functions.description: Completes a pending Esys_Duplicate_Async and returns duplication blobs and optional symmetric seed.
requirements: Must follow Esys_Duplicate_Async.
All out-parameters provided must be valid pointers; returned memory is callee-allocated and freed with Esys_Free.
No other command pending on esysContext.

functions.name: Esys_Rewrap
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Rewrap(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR oldParent, ESYS_TR newParent, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_PRIVATE *inDuplicate, const TPM2B_NAME *name, const TPM2B_ENCRYPTED_SECRET *inSymSeed, TPM2B_PRIVATE **outDuplicate, TPM2B_ENCRYPTED_SECRET **outSymSeed);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_Rewrap: rewraps a duplicate blob from an old parent to a new parent without access to object sensitive data.
requirements: oldParent and newParent must be valid handles with appropriate auth.
inDuplicate, name, and inSymSeed must point to valid input structures produced by duplication.
outDuplicate/outSymSeed must be non-NULL if outputs are required; returned memory must be freed with Esys_Free.

functions.name: Esys_Rewrap_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Rewrap_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR oldParent, ESYS_TR newParent, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_PRIVATE *inDuplicate, const TPM2B_NAME *name, const TPM2B_ENCRYPTED_SECRET *inSymSeed);
functions.description: Starts asynchronous TPM2_Rewrap to change the parent wrapping of a duplicate blob.
requirements: oldParent/newParent must be valid and authorized.
inDuplicate, name, inSymSeed must be valid input pointers.
Call Esys_Rewrap_Finish to obtain outputs.

functions.name: Esys_Rewrap_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Rewrap_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2B_PRIVATE **outDuplicate, TPM2B_ENCRYPTED_SECRET **outSymSeed);
functions.description: Completes a pending Esys_Rewrap_Async and returns the rewrapped duplicate and seed.
requirements: Must follow Esys_Rewrap_Async.
Out pointers must be valid; returned buffers are callee-allocated; free with Esys_Free.
esysContext must be in the correct state (no other pending command).

functions.name: Esys_Import
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Import(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR parentHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_DATA *encryptionKey, const TPM2B_PUBLIC *objectPublic, const TPM2B_PRIVATE *duplicate, const TPM2B_ENCRYPTED_SECRET *inSymSeed, const TPMT_SYM_DEF_OBJECT *symmetricAlg, TPM2B_PRIVATE **outPrivate);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_Import: imports an external or duplicated object under a parent, returning a TPM-private blob usable with the parent.
requirements: parentHandle must be a valid loaded parent key with import capability.
objectPublic, duplicate, and inSymSeed must be valid inputs produced by duplication or external construction; symmetricAlg/encryptionKey as required by scheme.
outPrivate must be non-NULL; returned buffer must be freed with Esys_Free.

functions.name: Esys_Import_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Import_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR parentHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_DATA *encryptionKey, const TPM2B_PUBLIC *objectPublic, const TPM2B_PRIVATE *duplicate, const TPM2B_ENCRYPTED_SECRET *inSymSeed, const TPMT_SYM_DEF_OBJECT *symmetricAlg);
functions.description: Starts asynchronous TPM2_Import to import an object under a parent key.
requirements: parentHandle must be valid and authorized.
Input pointers must reference valid structures consistent with the chosen scheme.
Call Esys_Import_Finish to obtain outPrivate.

functions.name: Esys_Import_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_Import_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2B_PRIVATE **outPrivate);
functions.description: Completes a pending Esys_Import_Async and returns the imported private blob.
requirements: Must follow Esys_Import_Async.
outPrivate must be a valid pointer; returned memory is callee-allocated; free with Esys_Free.
No other pending command on esysContext.

functions.name: Esys_RSA_Encrypt
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_RSA_Encrypt(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR keyHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_PUBLIC_KEY_RSA *message, const TPMT_RSA_DECRYPT *inScheme, const TPM2B_DATA *label, TPM2B_PUBLIC_KEY_RSA **outData);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_RSA_Encrypt: encrypts a message with an RSA public key using a specified scheme and optional label.
requirements: keyHandle must be an RSA key with public portion available and appropriate attributes for encryption.
message must fit key size and scheme constraints; inScheme and label must be consistent with the key and TPM rules.
outData must be non-NULL; returned buffer must be freed with Esys_Free.

functions.name: Esys_RSA_Encrypt_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_RSA_Encrypt_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR keyHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_PUBLIC_KEY_RSA *message, const TPMT_RSA_DECRYPT *inScheme, const TPM2B_DATA *label);
functions.description: Starts asynchronous TPM2_RSA_Encrypt to encrypt data with an RSA key.
requirements: keyHandle must be a valid RSA key handle.
message/inScheme/label must be valid per TPM rules and key capabilities.
Call Esys_RSA_Encrypt_Finish to retrieve outData.

functions.name: Esys_RSA_Encrypt_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_RSA_Encrypt_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2B_PUBLIC_KEY_RSA **outData);
functions.description: Completes a pending Esys_RSA_Encrypt_Async and returns the ciphertext.
requirements: Must follow Esys_RSA_Encrypt_Async.
outData must be a valid pointer; returned data is callee-allocated; free with Esys_Free.
No other pending command on esysContext.

functions.name: Esys_RSA_Decrypt
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_RSA_Decrypt(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR keyHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_PUBLIC_KEY_RSA *cipherText, const TPMT_RSA_DECRYPT *inScheme, const TPM2B_DATA *label, TPM2B_PUBLIC_KEY_RSA **message);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_RSA_Decrypt: decrypts RSA ciphertext using a private key on the TPM with a specified scheme and optional label.
requirements: keyHandle must be a loaded RSA key with decrypt capability and proper authorization.
cipherText must be valid and sized to key modulus; inScheme/label must match key capabilities and TPM constraints.
message must be non-NULL; returned buffer is callee-allocated; free with Esys_Free.

functions.name: Esys_RSA_Decrypt_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_RSA_Decrypt_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR keyHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_PUBLIC_KEY_RSA *cipherText, const TPMT_RSA_DECRYPT *inScheme, const TPM2B_DATA *label);
functions.description: Starts asynchronous TPM2_RSA_Decrypt to decrypt RSA ciphertext with a TPM key.
requirements: keyHandle must be a valid loaded RSA key with decrypt usage.
cipherText/inScheme/label must be valid pointers consistent with TPM rules.
Call Esys_RSA_Decrypt_Finish to retrieve message.

functions.name: Esys_RSA_Decrypt_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_RSA_Decrypt_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2B_PUBLIC_KEY_RSA **message);
functions.description: Completes a pending Esys_RSA_Decrypt_Async and returns the decrypted message.
requirements: Must be called after Esys_RSA_Decrypt_Async.
message must be a valid pointer; returned memory is callee-allocated; free with Esys_Free.
esysContext must not have another pending command.

functions.name: Esys_ECDH_KeyGen
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ECDH_KeyGen(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR keyHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, TPM2B_ECC_POINT **zPoint, TPM2B_ECC_POINT **pubPoint);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_ECDH_KeyGen: generates an ephemeral key pair and computes an ECDH shared secret with a TPM ECC key, returning Z and ephemeral public point.
requirements: keyHandle must be a loaded ECC key appropriate for ECDH.
zPoint and pubPoint must be non-NULL; outputs are callee-allocated and must be freed with Esys_Free.
Authorization sessions as required by key attributes.

functions.name: Esys_ECDH_KeyGen_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ECDH_KeyGen_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR keyHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3);
functions.description: Starts asynchronous TPM2_ECDH_KeyGen to compute ECDH secret and ephemeral point.
requirements: keyHandle must be a valid ECC key handle.
Call Esys_ECDH_KeyGen_Finish to retrieve zPoint and pubPoint.
Authorization sessions must be set if required.

functions.name: Esys_ECDH_KeyGen_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ECDH_KeyGen_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2B_ECC_POINT **zPoint, TPM2B_ECC_POINT **pubPoint);
functions.description: Completes a pending Esys_ECDH_KeyGen_Async and returns ECDH Z and ephemeral public point.
requirements: Must follow Esys_ECDH_KeyGen_Async.
zPoint and pubPoint must be valid pointers; returned structures are callee-allocated; free with Esys_Free.
No other pending command on esysContext.

functions.name: Esys_ECDH_ZGen
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ECDH_ZGen(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR keyHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_ECC_POINT *inPoint, TPM2B_ECC_POINT **outPoint);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_ECDH_ZGen: computes an ECDH shared secret using a TPM ECC key and a peer public point.
requirements: keyHandle must be a loaded ECC key with appropriate attributes.
inPoint must be a valid ECC public point on the same curve as the key.
outPoint must be non-NULL; returned buffer is callee-allocated; free with Esys_Free.

functions.name: Esys_ECDH_ZGen_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ECDH_ZGen_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR keyHandle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_ECC_POINT *inPoint);
functions.description: Starts asynchronous TPM2_ECDH_ZGen using an ECC key and input point.
requirements: keyHandle must be valid; inPoint must be a valid ECC point.
Call Esys_ECDH_ZGen_Finish to retrieve outPoint.
Authorization sessions set as required.

functions.name: Esys_ECDH_ZGen_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ECDH_ZGen_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPM2B_ECC_POINT **outPoint);
functions.description: Completes a pending Esys_ECDH_ZGen_Async and returns the ECDH shared secret point.
requirements: Must follow Esys_ECDH_ZGen_Async.
outPoint must be a valid pointer; returned structure is callee-allocated; free with Esys_Free.
esysContext must be idle (no other pending command).

functions.name: Esys_ECC_Parameters
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ECC_Parameters(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, TPMI_ECC_CURVE curveID, TPMS_ALGORITHM_DETAIL_ECC **parameters);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_ECC_Parameters: queries algorithm parameters for a given ECC curve.
requirements: curveID must be a supported curve identifier.
parameters must be a non-NULL pointer; returned structure is callee-allocated; free with Esys_Free.
Sessions may be ESYS_TR_NONE as appropriate.

functions.name: Esys_ECC_Parameters_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ECC_Parameters_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, TPMI_ECC_CURVE curveID);
functions.description: Starts asynchronous TPM2_ECC_Parameters to query ECC curve details.
requirements: curveID must be valid/supported.
Call Esys_ECC_Parameters_Finish to retrieve parameters.
esysContext must not have another pending command.

functions.name: Esys_ECC_Parameters_Finish
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ECC_Parameters_Finish(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, TPMS_ALGORITHM_DETAIL_ECC **parameters);
functions.description: Completes a pending Esys_ECC_Parameters_Async and returns ECC algorithm details.
requirements: Must follow Esys_ECC_Parameters_Async.
parameters must be a valid pointer; returned memory is callee-allocated; free with Esys_Free.
No other pending command on esysContext.

functions.name: Esys_ZGen_2Phase
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_ZGen_2Phase(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR keyA, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_ECC_POINT *inQsB, const TPM2B_ECC_POINT *inQeB, TPMI_ECC_KEY_EXCHANGE inScheme, UINT16 counter, TPM2B_ECC_POINT **outZ1, TPM2B_ECC_POINT **outZ2);
functions.description: Synchronous TPM2_ZGen_2Phase: performs a two-phase ECC key exchange using static and ephemeral keys, returning two shared points.
requirements: keyA must be a loaded ECC key supporting key exchange.
inQsB and inQeB must be valid ECC points; inScheme must identify a supported exchange scheme; counter per spec.

functions.name: Esys_HMAC_Async
functions.signature: TSS2_RC Esys_HMAC_Async(ESYS_CONTEXT *esysContext, ESYS_TR handle, ESYS_TR shandle1, ESYS_TR shandle2, ESYS_TR shandle3, const TPM2B_MAX_BUFFER *buffer, TPMI_ALG_HASH hashAlg);

generators.generator:
import random
import os
import struct

# Target: Generate a valid TPM command buffer-like byte sequence for Tss2_Tcti_Transmit fuzz stub.
# The stub takes FUZZ_PARAM_STR and slices it to size in [1..1024]. We should return bytes that
# resemble realistic TPM command headers so TCTI layers that parse headers (for size checks) see
# consistent data. TPM command header (TPM2) layout (big-endian):
#   tag (2 bytes: TPM_ST_NO_SESSIONS=0x8001 or TPM_ST_SESSIONS=0x8002)
#   size (4 bytes: total command size)
#   commandCode (4 bytes: e.g., TPM2_CC_GetRandom=0x0000017B)
# Followed by command parameters (may be empty depending on command).
# We'll generate a small set of plausible commands with minimal parameters to maximize validity
# across transports, but content remains opaque to TCTI. Keep total <= 1024.

TPM_ST_NO_SESSIONS = 0x8001
TPM_ST_SESSIONS = 0x8002

# A small catalogue of real TPM2 command codes that have simple/short parameter areas.
TPM_CC = {
    'Startup': 0x00000144,        # TPM2_Startup: params: TPM_SU (2 bytes)
    'Shutdown': 0x00000145,       # TPM2_Shutdown: params: TPM_SU (2 bytes)
    'GetRandom': 0x0000017B,      # TPM2_GetRandom: params: bytesRequested (UINT16)
    'ReadClock': 0x00000181,      # TPM2_ReadClock: no parameters
    'SelfTest': 0x00000143,       # TPM2_SelfTest: params: fullTest (TPMI_YES_NO, 1 byte)
}

# TPM2_SU values
TPM_SU_CLEAR = 0x0000
TPM_SU_STATE = 0x0001

# Helper: big-endian packers
pack_u16 = lambda v: struct.pack(">H", v & 0xFFFF)
pack_u32 = lambda v: struct.pack(">I", v & 0xFFFFFFFF)


def _cmd_startup(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    tag = TPM_ST_NO_SESSIONS
    cc = TPM_CC['Startup']
    startup_type = rnd.choice([TPM_SU_CLEAR, TPM_SU_STATE])
    params = pack_u16(startup_type)
    size = 10 + len(params)  # header(10) + params
    return pack_u16(tag) + pack_u32(size) + pack_u32(cc) + params


def _cmd_shutdown(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    tag = TPM_ST_NO_SESSIONS
    cc = TPM_CC['Shutdown']
    shutdown_type = rnd.choice([TPM_SU_CLEAR, TPM_SU_STATE])
    params = pack_u16(shutdown_type)
    size = 10 + len(params)
    return pack_u16(tag) + pack_u32(size) + pack_u32(cc) + params


def _cmd_getrandom(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    tag = TPM_ST_NO_SESSIONS
    cc = TPM_CC['GetRandom']
    # Request between 1 and 64 bytes (small; TPM may cap per implementation)
    req = rnd.randint(1, 64)
    params = pack_u16(req)
    size = 10 + len(params)
    return pack_u16(tag) + pack_u32(size) + pack_u32(cc) + params


def _cmd_readclock(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    tag = TPM_ST_NO_SESSIONS
    cc = TPM_CC['ReadClock']
    size = 10
    return pack_u16(tag) + pack_u32(size) + pack_u32(cc)


def _cmd_selftest(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    tag = TPM_ST_NO_SESSIONS
    cc = TPM_CC['SelfTest']
    full = rnd.choice([0x00, 0x01])  # TPMI_YES_NO
    params = bytes([full])
    size = 10 + len(params)
    return pack_u16(tag) + pack_u32(size) + pack_u32(cc) + params


_generators = [_cmd_startup, _cmd_shutdown, _cmd_getrandom, _cmd_readclock, _cmd_selftest]


def _pad_to_length(buf: bytes, target_len: int, rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    if len(buf) >= target_len:
        return buf[:target_len]
    # Fill with random bytes; not interpreted by TCTI, but some stacks may ignore tail beyond header size
    pad_len = target_len - len(buf)
    pad = rnd.randbytes(pad_len)
    return buf + pad


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    # Choose a base command form
    cmd_fn = rnd.choice(_generators)
    base = cmd_fn(rnd)

    # Optionally choose to embed as-is or extend with benign padding up to a small random size
    # The fuzz stub will take size = (len(buffer) % 1024) + 1, so larger buffers vary the transmitted size.
    # Keep total buffer <= 1024
    max_total = 1024
    # Target a transmitted size between len(base) and min(256, 1024)
    target = rnd.randint(len(base), min(256, max_total))
    out = _pad_to_length(base, target, rnd)
    # Ensure non-empty and within limit
    if not out:
        out = base
    return out[:max_total]
